meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 它会把一个项目在 claude-mem 中的完整历史按 ISO 周拆开，每一周生成一章叙事摘要；后一章会带入前一章的“故事接力”信息，使各章连成连贯的连载，最终输出按周编号的 Markdown 章节文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求“weekly digests”、“week-by-week story”、“serial timeline”等，把项目历史做成按周连载的叙事摘要时触发。

say.text: 把这个项目的完整历史做成逐周的连载叙事摘要。
say.note: Claude 会先按 ISO 周拆分，再逐章生成。

say.text: 从第一周开始，为这个项目每周写一章“故事至今”式摘要。
say.note: 首章无前文，后续章节自动衔接。

say.text: 为这个项目生成 story chapters，每个 ISO 周一章并编号。
say.note: 输出的章节文件按周排序。

howto.what_en: Splits the claude-mem timeline into ISO weeks and writes one serial narrative chapter per week; each chapter continues from the prior week's carry-forward block, producing numbered Markdown digest files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked for 'weekly digests', 'week-by-week story', 'serial timeline', or similar week-by-week narrative chapter requests.

say_en.text: Turn this project's whole history into week-by-week story chapters.
say_en.note: Claude splits by ISO week, then writes each chapter in order.

say_en.text: Start at week one and write a story-so-far style digest for each week.
say_en.note: Week 1 starts empty; later weeks inherit the carry-forward.

say_en.text: Write story chapters for this project, one per ISO week, numbered.
say_en.note: Digest files are saved in week order.
